channels.raw_text:
Example recording. A synthetic narrator is reading Apple's fiscal 2025 third quarter release. release. This is not an executive recording. Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2025 third quarter ended June 28, 2025. The company posted quarterly revenue of $94.0 billion, up 10% year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.67, up 12% year over year.

We are very pleased with our record business performance for the June quarter, which generated EPS growth of 12%, said Kevin Park, Apple's CFO.

End of example recording.

We are very pleased with our record business performance for the June quarter, which generated EPS growth of 12%, said Kevin Park, Apple's CFO.

End of example recording.
